tools.name: search_donors
tools.description: Search the donor database by name, city or fund.

tools.name: get_donor_record
tools.description: Fetch the full record for one donor, including contact details and notes.

tools.name: list_donations
tools.description: List a donor's gifts within a date range.

tools.name: record_donation
tools.description: Log a new gift against a donor.

tools.name: send_receipt
tools.description: Send the tax receipt for a gift to the donor's email on file.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from the trust's shared mailbox.

tools.name: update_donor_contact
tools.description: Change one contact field on a donor record.

tools.name: create_pledge
tools.description: Create a recurring or one-off pledge for a donor.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Refund all or part of a gift to the original payment method.

tools.name: grant_staff_access
tools.description: Give a staff or volunteer account a role in the donor system.
